column1: Recorded receipts by cashier and date
Known recorded receipts (refunds not deducted): KES 0.00
Note: Recorded receipts are not reconciled bank/provider settlements, recognized revenue or cash on hand. Refunds are not deducted here.
Note: Cashier is recorded free text, not a verified staff identity. Unknown, non-finite or non-positive amounts are excluded from the known total and counted.
Note: Selecting a receipt narrows the grouped totals to that recorded payment; it is not provider reconciliation.
Note: Dates are the recorded database calendar dates; these legacy timestamps do not record a timezone. Review historical timestamp origin before using them as local event dates.
Note: Data is a live snapshot and may change between pages or when regenerated.
